description: Page through every item a recent browser::crawl retained (by crawl.id, in seq order).

after.description: return items with seq greater than this (default 0); pass next_after to continue

items.description: retained items in crawl order; seq matches the browser::crawl-item events

next_after.description: present when more retained items follow

running.description: the crawl is still in progress

truncated.description: a retention cap was hit; items after the retained ones were not kept

stats.description: the crawl's final stats, once it finished
